name: @chrischall/hellofresh-mcp

tools.name: hf_healthcheck
tools.description: Check the HelloFresh connection end to end: the ContextMint Bridge link to your signed-in www.hellofresh.com tab (which holds the session), the session token (minutes to expiry, and a warning if a refreshed session could not be written back to the browser), and a probe of the HelloFresh subscriptions endpoint that returns only its status. Call it when another hf_ tool fails, to learn which hop broke (bridge, sign-in, or HelloFresh itself).

tools.name: hf_get_subscription
tools.description: Read the HelloFresh meal-kit subscription: the plan’s box size (meals × people, SKU), price per box, meal-preference preset, delivery weekday/slot and frequency, the next delivery week and its cutoff, pause/cancel state and the voucher (discount code). Never returns name, email, address or payment details.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact keeps the plan, schedule and voucher code; full adds the plan id and the voucher’s per-box discount rules.

tools.name: hf_list_deliveries
tools.description: List upcoming HelloFresh deliveries (about the next 7 weeks): each week’s delivery date, meal-pick cutoff, status (running, skipped, delivered), box size and, for running weeks, the box price — HelloFresh’s own checkout total (voucher, shipping and tax applied) plus the picked meals’ premium upcharge, or a labelled local estimate when that cannot be read. Answers "what HelloFresh boxes are coming?" — view "brief" gives one line per week (no prices).

view.description: "compact" (default): week, dates, status, box size and the price. "brief": one line per week, `2026-W49 — 2026-11-30 — running, 2×6, cutoff 11-25`, no prices (no per-week calls). "full": every allowlisted delivery field (allowed actions, alternative delivery-day slots) and, for an estimate, every estimate field.

next_box_number.description: Which box this account’s NEXT running delivery will be, counting every box ever delivered (1 = the first box). The voucher’s discount depends on it. Default: 1 when HelloFresh says the first box is not delivered yet; otherwise an assumed 2 (HelloFresh does not say how many boxes were delivered).

tools.name: hf_get_delivery
tools.description: Read one HelloFresh delivery week: delivery date and slot, meal-pick cutoff, status, box size, the meals currently picked (with any premium upcharge), allowed actions, alternative delivery days, and the box price — HelloFresh’s own checkout total plus the picked meals’ premium upcharge, or a labelled local estimate when that cannot be read.

week.description: The delivery week as an ISO week, e.g. 2026-W49 (from hf_list_deliveries).

box_number.description: This box’s number, counting every box ever delivered — overrides the number derived from next_box_number. Only used by the local estimate (when HelloFresh’s price cannot be read).

next_box_number.description: Which box this account’s NEXT running delivery will be, counting every box ever delivered (1 = the first box). The voucher’s discount depends on it. Default: 1 when HelloFresh says the first box is not delivered yet; otherwise an assumed 2 (HelloFresh does not say how many boxes were delivered).

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact keeps the essentials; full adds every allowlisted field (prices, slot handle, sub-status) and, for an estimate, every estimate field.

tools.name: hf_get_menu
tools.description: Read the HelloFresh menu for a delivery week at that week’s box size: every recipe with its index (used to pick meals), category, seafood kind (shrimp/fish/other), kid-friendly, quick, total minutes, premium upcharge per serving and per box, protein swaps (variants) and what is currently picked. Filters: seafood_only, kid_friendly, max_minutes, max_premium_per_serving, selected_only.

week.description: The delivery week as an ISO week, e.g. 2026-W49 (from hf_list_deliveries).

seafood_only.description: Only seafood dishes (a course is kept for a seafood protein swap).

kid_friendly.description: Only recipes HelloFresh tags kid friendly.

max_minutes.description: Only recipes that take at most this many minutes in total.

max_premium_per_serving.description: Highest premium upcharge per serving, in US cents (0 = no premium meals; 699 = up to $6.99).

selected_only.description: Only the meals currently picked for the week.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact keeps index, name, category, seafood kind, kid-friendly, quick, minutes, premiums (only when non-zero), selection and swaps; full adds headline, tags, cuisine, label and recipe URL.

tools.name: hf_list_box_sizes
tools.description: List the HelloFresh box sizes this subscription can switch to — meals per week × people (servings), with the SKU that names it — and mark the current plan size.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact is one flat list sorted by meals then people; full keeps HelloFresh’s product groups.

tools.name: hf_recent_picks
tools.description: List the HelloFresh meals picked in recent weeks — the current week and the weeks_back weeks before it — to avoid repeating a recipe. Best effort: each week’s menu is read separately, and weeks that cannot be read are listed with the reason. Weeks before the subscription’s first delivery week had no box (status no_box).

weeks_back.description: How many weeks before through_week to include (default 4).

through_week.description: The last week to include, as an ISO week (default: the current week).

tools.name: hf_select_meals
tools.description: Pick the meals for one HelloFresh delivery week, replacing the current picks. Give the menu indexes from hf_get_menu (a protein swap’s index works too); the count (with quantities) must equal the box’s meals per week, and only before the week’s cutoff. Re-reads the menu afterwards to verify the picks. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview.

week.description: The delivery week as an ISO week, e.g. 2026-W49 (from hf_list_deliveries).

meals.description: The COMPLETE selection: menu indexes, or {index, quantity} for more than one of a meal. A repeated index adds up.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

Read-only: pick with hf_select_meals.

tools.name: hf_plan_weeks
tools.description: Plan up to 6 HelloFresh delivery weeks in one read, each for the planner profile the caller names (hf_list_profiles): every week gets the same answer as hf_weekly_plan (box size needed, picks with alternates, price, summary, follow-up writes), and no recipe planned for an earlier week is suggested again in a later one (on top of the recent-picks rule). Returns a combined summary (one line per week), the total of HelloFresh’s own box prices (weeks with only a local estimate are named, not added), and the follow-up write calls per week in order (hf_set_week_size where needed, then hf_select_meals). A skipped week is reported as skipped, with no suggestions; a week whose menu HelloFresh has not published yet is reported as menu_not_published. Which profile each week gets (e.g. from a calendar) is the caller’s decision: this tool does not read a calendar. Read-only: it changes nothing.
